meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前摸清项目现状,产出一份可直接执行的工作计划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在改代码前希望先把方案定下来,避免边写边返工。
copy.tagline_en: Scope the codebase and write one ready-to-execute plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the plan settled before touching any code.

howto.what: Claude 会进入 ULW-PLAN 模式,当规划顾问:并行只读探查代码与资料,产出一份「决策完整」的工作计划,只写进 .omo/ 目录,从不改产品代码、不派实施类子代理。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流、或要在动手前先拿到一份计划时才接管;单独的 ulw 运行不会自动启用它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给支付模块重构写一份工作计划
say.note: 先只读探查,再产出计划文件

say.text: 先别写代码,把登录限流改造的计划给我
say.note: 不会开始实现,只写计划

say.text: 这份计划要高清度审查(high accuracy)
say.note: 交付前会加跑 plan-reviewer 审查

howto.what_en: Claude enters ULW-PLAN mode and acts as a planning consultant: read-only exploration of repo and docs, then one decision-complete work plan written only under .omo/. It never edits product code or dispatches implementers.
howto.when_en: It activates only on an explicit request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to write a work plan for the payments refactor
say_en.note: Read-only exploration first, then the plan

say_en.text: Don't code yet — give me the plan for the login rate-limit change
say_en.note: No implementation, only a plan file

say_en.text: This plan needs high accuracy review
say_en.note: Runs a plan-reviewer review before handoff
